description: This file defines an abstract class 'GenericMapEntrySet' that extends a generic set implementation for map entries, providing methods for containment checks and removal of entries in a map wrapper.

classes.name: GenericMapEntrySet
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base implementation for sets of map entries, with custom containment and removal logic.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a given object is a Map.Entry with matching key and value in the underlying source map.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the entry with the specified key from the source map if it exists.
